basic_profile.bio: Based in Toronto, I'm a 28-year-old Pokémon Go enthusiast who loves connecting with new trainers to tackle raids and expand my collection. By day, I work as a software developer, which gives me the flexibility to sneak in quick gaming sessions during breaks. In my free time, I also enjoy cycling, often exploring new trails, which led me to join the bikemaintenance subreddit for tips and advice. Although I'm currently single, I enjoy casual meetups and events, which occasionally leads me to explore the OntarioSwingers subreddit out of curiosity and social interest. I'm typically online in the evenings, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been coding since high school. My expertise lies in software development, particularly in mobile applications, which dovetails nicely with my interest in apps like Pokémon Go. I've also become quite knowledgeable about bike maintenance through repair workshops and online communities.
